prompt:
15-second ultra-realistic early-2000s Sony MiniDV home video, filmed casually by another person.

Subject: Young Korean woman, 24, naturally attractive, realistic skin, minimal makeup, long dark hair loosely down. Wearing an oversized maroon hoodie and loose casual pants, carrying a simple canvas shoulder bag. Preserve her exact identity, facial features, hairstyle, body proportions and appearance throughout.

Location & Atmosphere: Small old Seoul apartment during a dark, rainy early morning. Cozy bedroom connected to a small entryway, simple bed with a soft blanket, wooden furniture, rain-covered window showing blurred neighboring apartment buildings outside. Dark blue-hour ambience, cold blue-gray light from the rainy window mixed with weak warm interior light. Muted colors, soft shadows, slightly underexposed surroundings, steady rain outside. Quiet, sleepy, intimate atmosphere.

Style: Authentic early-2000s Sony MiniDV home-video footage filmed by another person. Completely candid and unstaged. Natural handheld movement, subtle camera shake, imperfect framing, gentle reframing, occasional autofocus hunting, mild exposure shifts, faded colors, soft contrast, authentic DV compression, subtle low-light digital noise and microphone noise. Smooth continuous real-time motion throughout. No stuttering, judder, frame skipping, duplicated frames, stop-motion appearance, excessive motion blur, speed changes, low-frame-rate look, stabilization or modern cinematic movement.

00:00–00:04: She sits on the edge of her bed, sleepy and slightly groggy, wearing her oversized maroon hoodie and loose casual pants. She stands up and reaches for her canvas shoulder bag near the doorway.

00:04–00:07: She takes a couple of steps toward the door, but the blanket is still loosely wrapped around one ankle. It gently pulls her foot backward. She stops and looks down, confused.

00:07–00:10: She tries taking another step. The blanket catches again and slides across the floor with her. She looks down at it with a mildly annoyed expression, then bends down and tries to free her ankle.

00:10–00:12: She finally gets her foot free, stands up and takes one confident step toward the door.

00:12–00:15: The blanket catches around her ankle one more time and gently pulls back. She freezes, looks down at it, then slowly looks directly at the camcorder with a completely deadpan expression. After a tiny sigh, she gives the blanket a small kick away and walks off.

Audio: Natural sound only—steady rain against the window, quiet apartment ambience, soft footsteps, fabric and blanket rustling across the floor, subtle clothing movement and her natural sigh. No music, narration or added sound effects.

Goal: Cute, relatable and lightly funny, like an ordinary sleepy morning accidentally captured on an old family MiniDV camera. The humor should come entirely from the blanket repeatedly refusing to let her leave. Her final deadpan look toward the camera is the comedic payoff.

Motion quality: Keep all movements smooth, continuous and physically realistic. The blanket must behave naturally with believable fabric physics and gentle tension when caught around her ankle. No sudden jerks, exaggerated pulling or chaotic movement. The vintage MiniDV aesthetic must come from image texture, autofocus, exposure behavior, muted colors and handheld operation—not reduced frame rate or choppy motion.

post.originalText:
Seedance 2.5

Prompt
15-second ultra-realistic early-2000s Sony MiniDV home video, filmed casually by another person.

Subject: Young Korean woman, 24, naturally attractive, realistic skin, minimal makeup, long dark hair loosely down. Wearing an oversized maroon hoodie and loose casual pants, carrying a simple canvas shoulder bag. Preserve her exact identity, facial features, hairstyle, body proportions and appearance throughout.

Location & Atmosphere: Small old Seoul apartment during a dark, rainy early morning. Cozy bedroom connected to a small entryway, simple bed with a soft blanket, wooden furniture, rain-covered window showing blurred neighboring apartment buildings outside. Dark blue-hour ambience, cold blue-gray light from the rainy window mixed with weak warm interior light. Muted colors, soft shadows, slightly underexposed surroundings, steady rain outside. Quiet, sleepy, intimate atmosphere.

Style: Authentic early-2000s Sony MiniDV home-video footage filmed by another person. Completely candid and unstaged. Natural handheld movement, subtle camera shake, imperfect framing, gentle reframing, occasional autofocus hunting, mild exposure shifts, faded colors, soft contrast, authentic DV compression, subtle low-light digital noise and microphone noise. Smooth continuous real-time motion throughout. No stuttering, judder, frame skipping, duplicated frames, stop-motion appearance, excessive motion blur, speed changes, low-frame-rate look, stabilization or modern cinematic movement.

00:00–00:04: She sits on the edge of her bed, sleepy and slightly groggy, wearing her oversized maroon hoodie and loose casual pants. She stands up and reaches for her canvas shoulder bag near the doorway.

00:04–00:07: She takes a couple of steps toward the door, but the blanket is still loosely wrapped around one ankle. It gently pulls her foot backward. She stops and looks down, confused.

00:07–00:10: She tries taking another step. The blanket catches again and slides across the floor with her. She looks down at it with a mildly annoyed expression, then bends down and tries to free her ankle.

00:10–00:12: She finally gets her foot free, stands up and takes one confident step toward the door.

00:12–00:15: The blanket catches around her ankle one more time and gently pulls back. She freezes, looks down at it, then slowly looks directly at the camcorder with a completely deadpan expression. After a tiny sigh, she gives the blanket a small kick away and walks off.

Audio: Natural sound only—steady rain against the window, quiet apartment ambience, soft footsteps, fabric and blanket rustling across the floor, subtle clothing movement and her natural sigh. No music, narration or added sound effects.

Goal: Cute, relatable and lightly funny, like an ordinary sleepy morning accidentally captured on an old family MiniDV camera. The humor should come entirely from the blanket repeatedly refusing to let her leave. Her final deadpan look toward the camera is the comedic payoff.

Motion quality: Keep all movements smooth, continuous and physically realistic. The blanket must behave naturally with believable fabric physics and gentle tension when caught around her ankle. No sudden jerks, exaggerated pulling or chaotic movement. The vintage MiniDV aesthetic must come from image texture, autofocus, exposure behavior, muted colors and handheld operation—not reduced frame rate or choppy motion.
